selection: v1.03's 165 cases by identity, all 117 of termination-crafted, and the 118 of termination-crafted-lit with the smallest sha256(name) -- 400 in total, all carrying an upstream no-overflow label; nothing removed, nothing filtered on outcome, no case added outside those directories
labels: expected_verdict of no-overflow.prp in the same .yml, for scoring only
purpose: precision: the 165-case interval is [-0.032,+0.097] on the in-fragment subset, which cannot separate a small lead from a small deficit; 400 cases can

held_out.note: these directories were all used by earlier experiments; this is a precision increase on the same population, NOT a held-out evaluation

llmloop_configuration: unchanged front end scripts/svcomp_translate.py with GHOST on and NOOVF on; deterministic default then polynomial profile only if the default does not prove; 60 samples, 150 rounds, 5 s per query, seed 1
cbmc_configuration: --no-standard-checks --signed-overflow-check --unwind 64 --unwinding-assertions, actual ABI; incomplete unrolling is UNKNOWN
ultimate_configuration: unmodified v0.3.2 release, default/bitvector portfolio, JVM Xmx1G, internal timeout 600 s inside the same 600 s host cap
timing: concurrent throughput observations, not cross-tool speedup; wait4 CPU, sampled group RSS, stdout/stderr and the actual command lines retained
